exceptions.rationale: SIP full-session probe (scripts/alpaca_sip_full_session_probe.py, Phase 1.6) proved this session's 5-minute intraday bars remain severely or meaningfully partial on the SIP feed (2/78 to 49/78 expected bars, 37-97% missing) even though the daily bar is complete. This mirrors the IEX-feed gap documented in reports/audit/data_source_decision_brief_20260716.md and is not resolved by a feed change alone.
exceptions.residual_impact_statement: Per reports/audit/sip_residual_impact_20260716.md: this date is not a monthly rebalance signal date and not a next-open execution date (category (c), all 4 known dates), and the ranking/selection engine (_relative_strength_daily_features via _daily_ohlcv_from_frame) is code-traced to depend exclusively on daily OHLCV with zero path through 130-min data -- so, with SIP providing complete daily coverage plus this exception, residual affected_rebalance_decision_count is 0 (down from 3,304/3,445 baselines). One secondary, non-decision-affecting nuance remains and is not softened: generate_relative_strength_rotation_signals (backtest/execution simulation only, a different function than the ranking engine) reindexes onto the 130-min timestamp index, so a full historical backtest spanning this date would silently skip same-day mark-to-market for every symbol on this date -- a simulation continuity artifact, not a trading decision.

exceptions.evidence_source: Public record of WarnerMedia-Discovery merger completion (2022-04-08) and WBD regular-way trading start (2022-04-11); actual first session in testdata/research_data/rs_v2_sip_market_data/daily/WBD_1D.csv is 2022-04-04, within the same merger-close week but not an exact match to the public regular-way date -- discrepancy disclosed, not resolved.
exceptions.reason: WBD (Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.) came into existence via the WarnerMedia-Discovery merger, which completed 2022-04-08; the combined company's 'regular way' trading under ticker WBD is publicly documented as beginning 2022-04-11. The actual first SIP session for WBD is 2022-04-04, five trading days earlier than the widely-reported regular-way start date. This is most consistent with when-issued/early trading being included under the WBD symbol in the SIP feed around the merger-close week, a known pattern for merger-driven ticker launches, but this specific classification of the 2022-04-04 through 2022-04-08 bars could not be independently confirmed from data available in this repository. Approved on the strength of the underlying corporate event (merger completion the same week), not on exact-day certainty; flagged for operator awareness.

BK (The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation) changed its NYSE ticker symbol from BK to BNY, effective 2026-05-21 (announced 2026-05-11). Company/legal name and CUSIP are unchanged -- this is a ticker-symbol change, not a delisting of the underlying entity. No SIP price history exists under the BK symbol after 2026-05-20, the last trading day before the change took effect. Live re-query against Alpaca SIP on 2026-07-18 confirmed zero BK data for any date after 2026-05-20 (see reports/audit/phase2c_residual_gap_characterization_20260718.md Task B), ruling out a transient acquisition/download failure -- the absence is genuine and matches the announced ticker-change date. Recorded in testdata/research_data/alpha_vantage_delisted.csv as a rename entry. BNY is NOT added to the frozen candidate universe or acquired under this exception -- that is a separate, open operator decision.

ABNB completed its IPO and began trading on NASDAQ on 2020-12-10; the first trade did not occur until 13:35 ET (confirmed via live Alpaca SIP query on 2026-07-18, matching the archived raw 5-minute data exactly). No trades exist for the 9:30-11:40 ET block on this date because the security had not yet begun trading; this is a genuine, real absence of trading activity, not a data-acquisition or aggregation defect (see reports/audit/phase2d_targeted_repairs_20260718.md, which corrected an earlier mischaracterization of this as an aggregation-labeling artifact).
exceptions.evidence_source: Live Alpaca SIP query, 2026-07-18: ABNB 2020-12-10 5-minute bars, first_trade_timestamp=2020-12-10T13:35:00-05:00, 66 rows returned, byte-identical to testdata/research_data/rs_v2_sip_market_data/raw_5min/ABNB_5min.csv.

exceptions.rationale: Live SIP probe (3 symbols: ABT, XOM, UNH, 2026-07-18) confirmed zero trades exist in the 11:40-13:50 ET window for these ultra-liquid, actively-traded names on 2022-01-24, while pre-market/after-hours data outside that window is present -- ruling out a market-wide halt or acquisition-side failure (a genuine feed outage affecting 101 of 178 candidate symbols simultaneously for a fixed 2h10m window, on an otherwise-ordinary trading Monday, is a known-shape provider-side SIP data hole; zero trades in that window for these liquid names is not plausible market reality). Daily bars for all 101 symbols are confirmed present and complete for this date -- only the 130-min intraday blocks are affected.
exceptions.residual_impact_statement: Cross-checked against the same 73-date monthly rebalance calendar used in Phase 1.6 (v2_coverage_forensics._monthly_rebalance_dates()): 2022-01-24 is neither a rebalance/signal-bar date nor a next-open execution date -- category (c), same as the 4 previously-approved dates. Daily data confirmed complete for all 101 affected symbols (0 missing). The ranking/selection engine (_relative_strength_daily_features via _daily_ohlcv_from_frame) is code-traced (unchanged since Phase 1.6) to depend exclusively on daily OHLCV with zero path through 130-min data. Residual affected_rebalance_decision_count: 0. Alpaca support follow-up on the root cause of this provider-side gap is noted as an open item, not resolved here.
